## Mail or fax Form SS-4

If your principal business, office or agency, or legal residence in the case of an individual, is located in:

Mail or fax Form SS-4 to:

One of the 50 states or the District of Columbia

Internal Revenue Service  
Attn: EIN Operation  
Cincinnati, OH 45999

Fax: 855-641-6935
irs.excerpt: The EIN fallback rail is published with exact coordinates: mail or fax Form SS-4 to "Internal Revenue Service, Attn: EIN Operation, Cincinnati, OH 45999, Fax: 855-641-6935" (for applicants in the 50 states or DC).

irs.quote: MeF uses the widely accepted Extensible Markup Language (XML) format.
irs.excerpt: Modernized e-File is a system-to-system machine channel: "MeF uses the widely accepted Extensible Markup Language (XML) format." Transmission requires becoming an Authorized IRS e-file Provider — a credentialed rail, not a public API.

irs.quote: it can take up to 45 days from the date of submission for the IRS to approve your e-file applicati
irs.excerpt: The e-file provider enrollment path is published with its clock: "it can take up to 45 days from the date of submission for the IRS to approve your e-file application" — and principals without professional status "need to be fingerprinted using the IRS authorized vendor".

irs.quote: need to be fingerprinted using the IRS authorized vendor
irs.excerpt: E-file provider suitability includes a physical step for non-credentialed principals: individuals without current professional status "need to be fingerprinted using the IRS authorized vendor" (Livescan).

irs.quote: IRIS Taxpayer Portal/UI and IRIS Application to Application (A2A)
irs.excerpt: A genuine machine intake exists for information returns: IRIS "receives information through two intake channels: IRIS Taxpayer Portal/UI and IRIS Application to Application (A2A)" — the A2A channel is gated by a Transmitter Control Code.

irs.quote: You’ll need an account with ID.me to sign in to access your tax information and use services on IRS.gov.
irs.excerpt: IRS online account sign-in requires identity proofing through ID.me: "You'll need an account with ID.me to sign in to access your tax information and use services on IRS.gov." The same page's data-handling note names "selfie, video, and biometric data" — a liveness check, which no agent can complete for a person.

irs.quote: All selfie, video, and biometric data are automatically deleted for users who verify for the IRS
irs.excerpt: The ID.me verification path is biometric: "All selfie, video, and biometric data are automatically deleted for users who verify for the IRS" — the account wall in front of IRS online services is a liveness check, not credential MFA.

irs.quote: You can make the choice by filing a written statement, or [Form 15620, Section 83(b) Election PDF](/pub/irs-pdf/f15620.pdf "0425 Form 15620                          (PDF)"), with the Internal Revenue Service Center where you file your return.
irs.excerpt: The 83(b) election's paper rail, in the IRS's own words (Pub 525 update): "You can make the choice by filing a written statement, or Form 15620, Section 83(b) Election, with the Internal Revenue Service Center where you file your return."

irs.quote: Online Account (OLA) is required to complete mobile friendly forms that require signatures.
irs.excerpt: An online rail now exists for signed forms including Form 15620 (83(b) election), but it ends at the taxpayer personally: "Online Account (OLA) is required to complete mobile friendly forms that require signatures" — and OLA sign-in is the ID.me liveness wall.

The EIN assistant documents a sanctioned delegation rail: a third-party designee may apply, with signed authorization from the responsible party — the published intermediary channel commercial formation services ride.

eftps.quote:
EFTPS is partnering with third-party credential service providers Login.gov and ID.me for MFA services.  
      
    Secure sign-in via Login.gov or ID.me is required as of **October 19, 2023**.
eftps.excerpt: MFA is mandatory on EFTPS: "EFTPS is partnering with third-party credential service providers Login.gov and ID.me for MFA services. Secure sign-in via Login.gov or ID.me is required as of October 19, 2023."

eftps.quote: you will receive a personal identification number (PIN) via U.S. Mail in five to seven business days
eftps.excerpt: Enrollment ends in physical mail: after IRS validation "you will receive a personal identification number (PIN) via U.S. Mail in five to seven business days" — a hard latency floor no online path removes.

eftps.quote: Payments using this Web site or our voice response system must be scheduled by **8 p.m. ET the day before the due date** to be received timely by the IRS.
eftps.excerpt: Published scheduling constraint: "Payments using this Web site or our voice response system must be scheduled by 8 p.m. ET the day before the due date to be received timely by the IRS."

eftps.quote:
No new enrollments for individual taxpayers

Individual taxpayers can no longer create new EFTPS accounts.
eftps.excerpt: The IRS's own EFTPS page: "No new enrollments for individual taxpayers — Individual taxpayers can no longer create new EFTPS accounts." The rail is business and tax-professional only going forward.

eftps.quote: If you're a tax professional, you can make payments for multiple clients under a single login. [Download the free Batch Provider Software](https://www.eftps.gov/eftps/direct/DownloadSoftware.page "EFTPS Download the free Batch Provider Software").
eftps.excerpt: The documented software channel is the Batch Provider program, not an API: "If you're a tax professional, you can make payments for multiple clients under a single login. Download the free Batch Provider Software."

eftps.quote: New enrollments for EFTPS can take up to five business days to process.
eftps.excerpt: Published enrollment clock: "New enrollments for EFTPS can take up to five business days to process."

uscis.quote:
Case Status API

Provides case status information to USCIS customers and their representatives who require regular access to case status information.
uscis.excerpt: A sanctioned machine rail exists for status: the Torch developer platform's "Case Status API — Provides case status information to USCIS customers and their representatives who require regular access to case status information", with developer accounts, API keys, and a sandbox.

uscis.quote:

uscis.excerpt: Second documented API on the Torch platform: "FOIA Request and Status — This API allows consumers to create a Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) or Privacy Act (PA) request" for Alien File material.

uscis.quote: Create a free online account first to file your application and start exploring all of our online services and tools.
uscis.excerpt: Online filing is account-based, stated up front: "Create a free online account first to file your application and start exploring all of our online services and tools." There is no filing API; myUSCIS is the only online filing rail.

uscis.quote: An attorney or accredited representative must submit Form G-28, Notice of Entry of Appearance as Attorney or Accredited Representative, to establish eligibility to represent a client in an immigration matter before USCIS.
uscis.excerpt: The delegation rail and its paperwork are published: "An attorney or accredited representative must submit Form G-28, Notice of Entry of Appearance as Attorney or Accredited Representative, to establish eligibility to represent a client in an immigration matter before USCIS."

uspto.quote: create a USPTO.gov account](https://account.uspto.gov/profile/create-account) with [multifactor authentication methods](/about-us/usptogov-account/secure-authentication "New options for more secure authentication") and verify your identity before you can log in to access TEAS and Trademark Center

uspto.quote: preview TEAS forms without logging in
uspto.excerpt: A keyless preview path is published: "You can preview TEAS forms without logging in" — the forms are inspectable before the account wall.

delaware-doc.excerpt: Formation has no transactional portal: "The entity forms are PDF fillable and can be submitted using our Document Filing and Certificate Request Service" — upload, fax, or mail; registered agents are the de facto service layer.
